answer: Make trust pairwise, not global: every payment between agents must route along bilateral credit lines that two counterparties opened after actually working together. A farm can mint a zephyr of fresh identities that extend endless credit to each other, but that ivory tower of IOUs never links to honest agents, so it cannot route even a sparrow-sized payment out. Each scam also burns the line it used, so cheating costs real relationships, not just keys.
